changelog.zh:
- 修复：直播偶发卡顿——启动时“缓冲强度”设置不生效（重启后固定回 32MB/fast）
- 修复：磁盘缓存创建失败后退化为 128KiB 流缓冲，网络一抖动就卡死
- 优化：缓冲强度真正控制预读窗口/缓存秒数/流缓冲/网络超时（快速 2s、平衡 4s、稳定 8s）
- 优化：临时性网络错误改为原地软重载，不再触发换源或重建播放器（避免数秒黑屏）
- 优化：软解回退每路播放只触发一次，减少重复重建
- 新增：播放统计改用 mpv 真实数据（实际帧率、丢帧数、缓存时长）
- 优化：降低播放页 UI 刷新频率与 mpv 日志开销，减轻高刷屏上的轻微抖动
changelog.en:
- Fix: occasional live playback stutter — buffer strength was ignored at startup (always 32MB/fast after restart)
- Fix: a failed file cache degraded to a 128KiB stream buffer, so any network jitter froze video
- Improvement: buffer strength now really controls readahead / cache seconds / stream buffer / network timeout (fast 2s, balanced 4s, stable 8s)
- Improvement: transient network errors now soft-reload in place instead of switching source or rebuilding the player
- Improvement: software fallback runs at most once per playback
- New: real playback stats from mpv (estimated fps, dropped frames, cache seconds)
- Improvement: lower UI refresh rate and mpv log overhead to reduce micro-stutter on high refresh displays
